changes.from: Only Space adds the trailing space; Enter and number keys (and clicking a candidate) commit the word without it, as the task suggested by default.

The raw letter string (and Space with no candidate) counts as English and gets the space too; a candidate that covers only the start of the letters (partial pick) adds no space, since typing continues.
Updated MomentumTests (Space on 'is' now commits 'is '), the Space row of the three READMEs and the iOS demo hint text.
